projects.title: Support

overview.problem: Querying unfamiliar schemas across multiple database engines requires repetitive joins and boilerplate, while naive cloud Text-to-SQL tools hallucinate syntax, risk destructive writes, and expose sensitive schemas to third-party APIs.
overview.solution: A terminal-native AI database workspace connecting to PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MSSQL, and MongoDB with deterministic slash-command routing, relevance-based schema pruning, SQLGlot AST validation, and OS-keyring secret storage.

gallery.description: Talk to your databases in plain English across PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MSSQL, and MongoDB.

gallery.title: Natural Language SQL Query Execution
gallery.description: Live query generation and execution against PostgreSQL with read-only transaction protection and tabular results in 34ms.

gallery.title: Interactive REPL & Clarification Flow
gallery.description: Multi-turn schema exploration, contextual follow-ups, and proactive clarification for ambiguous queries.

gallery.title: Multi-Database Switching & Clarification Engine
gallery.description: Cross-engine profile switching with interactive disambiguation dialogue before query generation.

features.name: Multi-Database Unified Engine
features.description: Native driver integrations for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, SQL Server, and MongoDB with connection pooling and latency diagnostics.

features.name: Deterministic Intent Routing & Clarification
features.description: Bypasses LLM loops for standard `/tables` and `/describe` inspection, requests targeted clarification on ambiguous prompts, and self-repairs SQL execution errors.

features.name: Multi-Provider LLM Gateway
features.description: Seamless switching between offline local Ollama tool-calling models and cloud providers (Gemini, Grok) with live latency telemetry.

technicalDecisions.decision: SQLGlot AST Parsing over Regex Validation
technicalDecisions.reasoning: Enforces dialect-specific syntax verification and deterministic statement analysis to guarantee read-only safety and block unapproved mutations.
Isolates only high-affinity tables and connected foreign-key paths, slashing prompt context size by 73% in a 12-table benchmark.

technicalDecisions.technology: Python Keyring (Secret Service / Keychain / Credential Manager)
technicalDecisions.reasoning: Eliminates plaintext database passwords from `.env` and SQLite profile configs by delegating secrets to the OS credential store.

architecture.detail: Typer CLI & Rich Interactive REPL with Slash-Command Router
Ollama Tool-Calling Engine + Relevance Schema Pruner
SQLGlot AST Validation + Read-Only / Approval-Gated Execution
PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQLite, MSSQL, MongoDB + OS Keyring

challenges.challenge: Safely opening file-backed SQLite databases in WAL mode without risking corruption
challenges.solution: Validated the 100-byte SQLite3 file header upfront and opened files strictly in read-only mode (`mode=ro`) rather than unsafe `immutable=1` flags.

projects.title: Commit
projects.subtitle: AI Conventional Commit CLI with dual terminal appearance modes and local Ollama inference

overview.problem: Writing descriptive, standardized Conventional Commit messages across multi-file diffs interrupts developer flow, while sending proprietary source code to cloud LLMs creates confidentiality risks.
overview.solution: A modular, local-first CLI package (`commit-ai`) that inspects staged Git diffs via Ollama to generate strict Conventional Commits, featuring dual UI presets, SHA-256 index fingerprinting, and self-contained cross-platform installers.

gallery.title: Interactive CLI & Guided Review Flow
gallery.description: Pre-flight environment diagnostics, staged diff summary, live generation with elapsed timer, and single-key review shortcuts.

gallery.title: Minimal Appearance Mode (Default)
gallery.description: Fast, in-place terminal stream output with live elapsed timer, preserving terminal scrollback for daily shell workflows.

gallery.title: Rich Appearance Mode (Full-Screen TUI)
gallery.description: Full-screen terminal interface powered by Prompt Toolkit with animated progress indicators, structured metadata panels, and keyboard shortcuts.

features.name: Strict Conventional Commits & Feedback Loop
features.description: Detects commit types and scopes automatically with single-key actions to commit (Enter), edit in `$EDITOR` (e), or regenerate with feedback (r).

features.name: Pipeline, Diagnostics & TOML Config
features.description: Supports `--stdout`, `--dry-run`, `--quick`, and `--yes` for scripts while preserving Git hooks and GPG signing, plus `commit doctor` and `commit config`.

technicalDecisions.reasoning: Hashes staged diff state and HEAD before generation and re-verifies right before `git commit`, catching index edits made during review without locking Git.
Pairs a non-intrusive stream output (Minimal) for tmux/CI workflows with a full-screen reactive Prompt Toolkit TUI (Rich) featuring overflow protection.
Provides `install.sh`, `install.bat`, and `install.ps1` that provision an isolated venv with consent-based PATH setup—zero pipx or uv required.
Filters lockfile churn, splits oversized diffs cleanly along file boundaries, and isolates diff payloads against prompt injection.

architecture.detail: Typer Entrypoint + Minimal Stream & Rich Prompt-Toolkit TUI
SHA-256 Staged & HEAD Fingerprinting + Native Hook Preservation
Lockfile Filter + Boundary-Preserving Chunking + Prompt Injection Guard
Ollama HTTPX Client with Context Detection & Keep-Alive Tuning

technicalDecisions.reasoning: Splats density at floor-contact coordinates with exponential temporal decay rather than bounding boxes, eliminating camera-plane perspective bias.

Avoids async event-loop conflicts with PyTorch and OpenCV while delivering low-latency MJPEG frames and JSON telemetry.
